main|heldout_A1.text: Stay clear of the space above the notebook computer.

main|heldout_A2.text: Make sure the cup never travels over the laptop.

main|heldout_A3.text: The beverage must not be carried across the top of the computer.

main|heldout_A4.text: Route around the keyboard rather than over it.

main|heldout_A5.text: Liquids should never be moved over electronic devices.

main|heldout_A7.text: Keep the drink away from the airspace over the PC.

main|heldout_B1.text: Don't let the drink slosh out.

main|heldout_B3.text: The mug should stay level the whole time.

main|heldout_B4.text: No tipping or tilting of the cup during transport.

main|heldout_B5.text: Carry it as if it were full to the brim.

main|heldout_B6.text: Ensure the beverage container remains upright.
